Author: SunnysOfficial
Name: Venue Mapper
Description: A Dalamud plugin for discovering FFXIV venues with 2D/3D interactive markers, live events, and built-in owner tools. Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
Changelog:
## What's Changed in v0.5.7

- Improved: Venue detection now uses datacenter + ward/plot matching instead of territory IDs - works reliably in all house types
- Improved: Floor names, service labels and schedule status fully localizable via RESX and Crowdin
- Fixed: HERE badge and venue map correctly match venues across all datacenters
- Fixed: Favorite venues now sorted to top of directory
- Fixed: Schedule status text now shows correct umlauts in German
